notes.title: Post-launch patch 1 (10.8.6)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added main volume slider to option menu
[*] Added a display for the current version id in the main menu
[*] Proper gamepad (xbox) support for the main, pause and option menus (especialy resolution dropdown)
[*] Fix: the light on pods' circular switch now flick properly
[/list]
[b]Stay tuned for more upcoming releases and patchs.[/b]

A huge thanks to all who got the game and their support during developement!

Arkitek,
Kernel Red Games

notes.title: PLAYTEST SESSION #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577574/0498d6548f410fd5df284093a9632a20f69500a5.png[/img]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3598550/Atlas_Hands/]Subscribe from the store page[/url]![/h3]

Hello everyone!

[b]In this first playtest session, we aim to understand how the game plays for you: your thoughts about the tone, gameplay and visual style[/b].

[h2]Atlas Hands is a horror maze about spheres[/h2]
The game tends to be a unique horror experience in its original approach of gameplay. What we seek the most is the [b]right balance and blend between puzzle solving and thrilling encounters[/b].

[h2]Your goal[/h2]
What is this playtest session for?
[list]
[*] On what configuration are you running the game and does it play smoothly
[*] How does the main gameplay loop feel
[*] How the mood, tone and visual style hit you, either good or bad
[*] Do the very little elements of narrative still made you curious
[/list]
[h2]How to[/h2]
[b]How can I participate?[/b]
[i]Playtest subscription is open to anyone for more than a week. Simply go on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3598550/Atlas_Hands/]store page [/url]to subscribe![/i]

[b]Where do I report my feedback?[/b]
[i]Directely from the game pause menu, hit the "Report Feedback" button: it will redirect to the feedback report form. Same goes for a bug if you encounter them. Don't hesitate to fill as much bug reports as it is necessary![/i]

[b]What if I'm having technical issues with the game?[/b]
[i]For any trouble or thought regarding technical issues or your feeling about the demo (good, bad, your expectations in the future, etc.), feel free to share it in the [b]dedicated forum of the playtest[/b].[/i]

[b]Controller support[/b]
[i]Right now, the game is full [b] xbox controller[/b] support, as well as [b]mouse/keyboard[/b].[/i]
